mapping.summary: Hosted admin tool to browse BC data, make reviewed bulk edits and fix RapidStart packages.
claims: Reads each tenant's API metadata so all entities, including extension fields, can be browsed
Visual filter builder or raw OData filter editing
Navigate record relationships, enums and bound actions
Switch between companies and environments in one tenant
Bulk updates can set fixed values or per-record expressions
Shows a field-level diff of all affected records before writing
Changes apply only after approval, with a report of each run
Any run can be reversed from its report
Explains configuration package errors in plain language with the fix
Fix package values in place and re-apply without rebuilding
Inspects .rapidstart files for duplicate keys and missing field ids before import
Upload, import and apply packages from one screen with logging
Users sign in with their own work account so BC permissions and change log apply per user
Stores only job plans and run reports outside BC
BC online only; on-premises is not supported
No extension needs installing; setup uses an admin consent link
